storefront.redactions: Client keys, tokens, license keys, client IDs and the embedded pusher secret in the environment config; Google Maps URL key. No government fields removed.

discovery.observedMechanism: Ember storefront with React integration. Browser network captured general_settings/1; public app code identifies search_results and JSON:API record routes. Newburyport address input remained Searching while the challenge credential was unavailable. No challenge interaction or clearance reuse.

apiResponses.bodyPolicy: Each numbered JSON file is the complete unmodified HTTP response body. No credentials, cookies or response headers retained.

liveResults.note: Adapter invocation logs, not government record fixtures. count=null means error, not no results. Initial Watertown redirects failed before the redirect fix; subsequent invocations supersede those. Recent calls return the unsupported sentinel and issue no portal requests.
